Export an exact native mgcv fitting specification

as_mgcv_spec.Rd

Converts a prepared CDR-GAM design into native mgcv arguments. Impulse-response functions become meaningfully named matrix terms. Scalar models carry their exact penalties through paraPen. Distributional models use mgcv's prefit G interface because mgcv::gam() does not accept paraPen with a formula list. The export does not use CDR-GAM's private compressed smooth constructor.

Usage

as_mgcv_spec(x, family = stats::gaussian(), method = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A cdrgam_design returned by prepare_cdrgam().

family

A family accepted by mgcv::gam(). Distributional designs require their corresponding general family.

method

Optional smoothing-parameter estimation method.

...

Additional arguments to include in the mgcv::gam() call.

Value

A named argument list suitable for do.call(mgcv::gam, spec).

Details

The returned data materialize grouped impulse-response designs. This interface supports interoperability and numerical validation; it is not the memory-efficient fitting path used by the sparse backend. Boundary-reduced fitted models are not supported.
